name: 5.11 Tactical RUSH72 2.0 55 L backpack
summary: A large compartmentalized pack for an evacuation load or a planned multi-day outing. Its 55 L capacity is a manufacturer specification, not a guarantee of comfortable carrying weight.
description: Organize an evacuation load by what you need to reach first: documents, water, a light and a weather layer. The RUSH72 2.0 provides a substantial main compartment and external organization, but filling every pocket can make it difficult to carry. Pack to your own walking ability, test the fit with your intended load and keep critical items accessible without emptying the bag.

specs.label: Fabric
specs.value: 1050D nylon for standard colours; MultiCam uses a different fabric

specs.label: Hydration compartment
specs.value: Rear compartment described for a 3 L reservoir; included reservoir not established

specs.label: Support
specs.value: Contoured shoulder straps, waist strap and reinforced back with aluminium stay

pros: Multiple compartments support an organized grab-and-go inventory.
External webbing provides attachment options for compatible pouches.
cons: A 55 L load can become heavy before the bag is full.
Water-repellent fabric does not establish waterproof storage.
Colour, seller and included accessories of the recorded ASIN are unverified.
useCases: Build and periodically check a household evacuation bag.
Carry a deliberately limited load on a planned outing after checking fit.

safetyNotes: Keep load within your own carrying ability; pack capacity is not a recommended lifting limit.
Protect water-sensitive supplies separately; do not treat the pack as a dry bag.
Keep straps secure and inspect seams, zippers and attachment points before travel.
